description: Search USPTO-recorded patent assignment/conveyance history by assignee, assignor, a granted patent number, or an application number — one of the four is required. Unlike `get_patent_assignments` (which needs an application number you already have), this answers "what has company X been assigned" or "who assigned patent Y". An `assignee`/`assignor` search returns one row per recorded assignment (reel/frame, conveyance, dates, the other party) and additionally resolves the covered property (application/patent number, title) for each one it returns via a follow-up lookup — capped by `limit` because each one is a separate upstream call. A `patent_number`/`application_number` search returns the full assignment chain for that one property directly. An assignee/assignor with no recorded assignments returns a plain zero with the upstream total, not an error — USPTO assignment coverage is uneven for older or never-assigned properties. Individual (non-corporate) assignee addresses are omitted; company addresses are kept. Powered by the USPTO Assignment Search system (public, no account or key required).

_apiKey.description: Not used by this tool — USPTO Assignment Search is keyless. Present only for schema parity with the other tools in this pack.

application_number.description: A US application number, digits only or formatted. Example: "15000001", "15/000,001".

assignee.description: Company or person the patent was assigned TO (the recipient). Partial/substring match. Example: "Amyris".

assignor.description: Company or person who assigned the patent AWAY (the inventor or prior owner). Partial/substring match. Example: "Musk"

limit.description: Maximum assignment records to return (default 10, max 25). For an assignee/assignor search this also bounds the number of follow-up property lookups, so a higher limit costs more upstream calls.

patent_number.description: A granted US patent number, digits only. Example: "10000000".

name: search_patent_assignments
title: Search Patent Assignments
